summary.text: Ruby is a pinkish-red to blood-red gemstone, a variety of the mineral corundum, which is aluminium oxide.
Its red comes from chromium: when chromium replaces some aluminium, it absorbs yellow-green light and also glows with red light.
Gem corundum of other colours is called sapphire, so ruby and sapphire are the same mineral in different colours.

items.prompt: Ruby and blue sapphire look nothing alike. What is the actual relationship between them?

options.label: Ruby is a harder mineral that forms deeper
Sapphire is a glass imitation of ruby
The same mineral in different colours
They are unrelated minerals often found together

items.explain: Ruby is red gem corundum; other gem-quality corundum is called sapphire, so rubies are sometimes called red sapphires.

items.prompt: Pure corundum, with nothing mixed in, is clear. What turns it into ruby?
items.explain: Pure corundum is colorless; chromium in place of some aluminium makes it absorb yellow-green light, giving red.

items.prompt: A ruby being sold as natural has no needle-like inclusions at all. What might a careful gemologist suspect?

options.label: It is an unusually perfect natural stone
It was mined at very great depth

items.explain: A ruby with no rutile needle inclusions may indicate the stone has been treated.

items.prompt: In the United States, a light pink corundum gem falls short of the minimum colour saturation for a ruby. What is it sold as?
items.explain: Below the US saturation minimum, red-family corundum is called pink sapphire instead of ruby.

items.prompt: Light bounces repeatedly through a ruby crystal between mirrors. What does this setup produce?

options.label: An intense beam of coherent red light
A glow that slowly fades to pink

items.explain: Photons at 694 nm trigger more in-phase red photons; passing them back and forth through the crystal makes a ruby laser.

items.prompt: Some rubies show a moving six-rayed star when cut into a dome. What causes it?

options.label: Light reflecting off aligned rutile needles
Air bubbles trapped in a ring

items.explain: The star appears when light reflects off the 'silk', the oriented rutile needle inclusions; here inclusions raise the value.
